success_patterns: For cheapest-offer tasks, compare qualifying offers across all shops and return every offer tied at the lowest price.

patch.reasoning: The skill already instructs agents to compare shops and follow pagination, but does not explicitly say to preserve all offers tied at the minimum. Two trajectories required returning every tied-lowest offer, so this closes a useful gap in the cheapest-search guidance.

edits.target: 6. For cheapest searches, use ascending price sorting on E-Store Athletes, CamelCases, and Hardware Cafe. Compare TechTalk results yourself; its sorting controls do not offer price sorting.
edits.content: - After checking all shops and remaining result pages, return every qualifying offer tied at the lowest price; do not stop at the first lowest-priced result.
